name: Bulacan Marathon 2026
short_description: The Bulacan Marathon 2026 is a full-marathon race held on August 9, 2026, at SM Center Pulilan in Pulilan, Bulacan, Philippines.
ai_summary: The Bulacan Marathon 2026 is a full-marathon event scheduled for August 9, 2026, in Pulilan, Bulacan, Philippines. Hosted at SM Center Pulilan, the race offers four distance options: 42.195km, 21.1km, 10km, and 5km, catering to a range of runner abilities. It is organized by Team Malofit x Pairfect Fit.
pros: Eight-hour marathon limit, generous for slower runners
Aid marked every 1.5 to 2 km on the marathon route map
Entry from P899 (5K) to P2,299 (42K) with a finisher shirt and medal
Full chip-timed results published for every distance
cons: 1am marathon start, so much of the race is in the dark
Heavy rain and a pre-dawn thunderstorm in 2026
Some riverside stretches described as unlit and uneven
Route maps and kit-claiming schedule published only on Facebook
research_highlights: The marathon is billed as an expansion of the organisers' Bulacan Half Marathon, presented "from the success of the Bulacan Half Marathon and due to insistent demand from the running community" (Takbo.ph).
Four distance options are offered: 42K, 21K, 10K and 5K, based on official event listings (runph.org, BaseKM).
Start and finish are at SM Center Pulilan, Pulilan, Bulacan, on 9 August 2026, per the official poster and race schedule.
The registration page promised 'BM Vamos Socks' to the first 1,000 42KM and first 1,500 21KM registrants.
Walk-in registration was at Pairfect Fit, Banga 1st, Plaridel, Bulacan (in front of Waltermart), per the official poster.

faqs.question: When is the Bulacan Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Bulacan Marathon 2026 took place on Sunday 9 August 2026 at SM Center Pulilan in Pulilan, Bulacan, Philippines. The 42K gun start was at 1am, followed by the 21K at 4am, the 10K at 4:30am and the 5K at 5am, according to the official race schedule.

faqs.question: What distances can participants choose from?
faqs.answer: Participants in the Bulacan Marathon 2026 can choose from four distance categories: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a 5km race, allowing runners of varying experience levels to take part in the event.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The Bulacan Marathon 2026 is held at SM Center Pulilan, located in Pulilan, Bulacan, Philippines. This venue serves as the base for the event, which features multiple race distances including the full marathon, half marathon, 10km, and 5km categories.

faqs.question: Who is organizing the Bulacan Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The Bulacan Marathon 2026 is organized by Team Malofit x Pairfect Fit. They are responsible for coordinating the event, which takes place at SM Center Pulilan in Pulilan, Bulacan, Philippines, and includes full marathon, half marathon, 10km, and 5km distance options.
